about: Extractor blockers (tools/extract/frontend.lisp: a function with no executable body, no attachment, not a primitive) that the gate (tools/extract/gate.py) accepts. chicken.py compiles each to a procedure that faults by name when called; the gate fails on any blocker not declared here, and every declared one is listed in the run's extraction manifest. Empty since lane extract-writable: ACL2::FN-SIG-VERIFY, the last one, is bound to the image's ML-DSA-65 verifier in both the image (host/native/signatures.lisp) and the program (tools/extract/native.scm), A-SIG-NATIVE.
